summary: This paper investigates automatic paraphrase identification using the Sentence-BERT (SBERT) model. Researchers developed an algorithm to identify semantically similar sentences within a custom English news corpus focused on COVID-19. SBERT demonstrated superior processing speed and accuracy compared to standard BERT, achieving a 77% precision rate in identifying paraphrases across different news sources.
keywords: Sentence-BERT, paraphrase identification, semantic similarity, news corpus, COVID-19
topics: Natural Language Processing, Information Retrieval, Computational Linguistics
